controls: Tenant-scoped artifacts are rejected when tenant context is missing or mismatched.
Selection authorization is an explicit fail-closed port.
Artifact feature flags and tenant allowlist gate before candidate ranking.
Parameter bindings preserve source, trust and confidence; critical model defaults are rejected.
Restricted AST conditions execute no generated source.
P07 emits audit data and a durable P06 revalidation request; it has no lifecycle-status write or physical execution capability.
audit: P02 artifact_match_log plus runtime_candidate_decision child record preserve matcher/policy snapshot hashes and stable reason codes
